questions.evidence: In a fictional paper-airplane activity, Team Red reports that its plane reached a target in one of one trial. Team Blue reports eight successes in ten trials. A poster calls Red's design 'the best' because its success rate is one hundred percent, while Blue's is eighty percent.

questions.evidence: The teacher asks students to include the numbers behind the percentages. Red has only one recorded attempt, so its perfect percentage gives little information about repeated performance. Blue's ten trials provide more observations, though conditions still need checking before a fair design comparison.
questions.explanation: 單次成功缺乏重複表現資訊，條件也需一致。
options: It is based on only one attempt and comparison conditions need checking.
Red is proven to fail every later trial.
One hundred percent is mathematically impossible.
questions.prompt: Why is Red's perfect percentage insufficient to establish the best design?

questions.evidence: The teams plan additional trials with the same target distance and agreed launch procedure. They will keep unsuccessful attempts in the record as well as successes. lessons.story:
In a fictional paper-airplane activity, Team Red reports that its plane reached a target in one of one trial. Team Blue reports eight successes in ten trials. A poster calls Red's design 'the best' because its success rate is one hundred percent, while Blue's is eighty percent.

The teacher asks students to include the numbers behind the percentages. Red has only one recorded attempt, so its perfect percentage gives little information about repeated performance. Blue's ten trials provide more observations, though conditions still need checking before a fair design comparison.

The teams plan additional trials with the same target distance and agreed launch procedure. They will keep unsuccessful attempts in the record as well as successes. The activity does not show that Red's plane is poor. It shows why a striking percentage should be read together with the amount and quality of evidence behind it.
lessons.title: The Hundred Percent Success Poster
